6781.title: Whole-transcript allocations hide fork failures
6781.rootCauseOneLine: A whole-file UTF-8 read exceeds Node’s string limit; the catch-all hides RangeError as session absence. Whole-output serialization has the same limit.

prReviews.topFinding: Incremental I/O addresses both allocations in the diff; its small mocked-reader checkpoint test does not prove above-cap full output. No PR code run.

6781.proposedFix: Incrementally read JSONL and stream serialized entries with backpressure; preserve meaningful I/O errors. Open PR #6782 already links to the issue, so no duplicate fix was attempted.
6781.caveats: Two same-agent Linux/Node 22 provider-boundary runs, not desktop E2E; production writer unreachable on baseline, with a primitive-only join probe; no real transcripts or PR code run.
